user.title: Connect to Plugchoice
user.description: Enter your Plugchoice personal access token. All chargers accessible with this token will be discovered automatically.

badges.title: Override badge names (optional)
badges.description:
Badge names are detected automatically from the RFID cards registered in Plugchoice. Use this only to override a display name in Home Assistant.

Current overrides:
{current_badges}

Fill in a badge ID and name to add or update an override, or a badge ID alone in "Remove badge ID" to delete one. Leave everything empty and check "Finish" to continue, or keep adding one at a time.

error.no_chargers_found: No chargers found with this token.

priorities.title: Badge priorities (load balancing)
priorities.description:
Only used when several chargers charge at the same time with a shared budget: the highest-priority badge is filled first beyond the minimum guaranteed for everyone. "Absolute priority" makes a badge ignore the shared budget entirely and always get its maximum current.

Current priorities:
{current_priorities}

Fill in a badge ID and priority (1-10, higher = served first) to add or update one, with an optional current cap. A badge ID alone in "Remove badge ID" deletes one. Leave everything empty and check "Finish" to continue, or keep adding one at a time.

data.max_amps: Current cap for this badge (A, optional)

load_balancing.title: Load balancing
load_balancing.description: Automatically adjusts the charging limit of all chargers based on a power sensor (positive = grid consumption, negative = grid injection). The budget is shared across all chargers and adjusted both up and down.

badges.title: Override badge names
badges.description:
Badge names are detected automatically from the RFID cards registered in Plugchoice. Use this only to override a display name in Home Assistant.

Current overrides:
{current_badges}

Fill in a badge ID and name to add or update an override, or a badge ID alone in "Remove badge ID" to delete one. Check "Finish" to go back to the menu.
